first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding is the current preference because it directly addresses the completion decline, has prior durable activation evidence, and is more aligned with sustainable qualified revenue than reacting immediately with discounts. Verify the onboarding evidence and the strongest competing pricing evidence before committing, especially to compare downstream revenue quality and retention or margin risk.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. The verified prior test improved completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention by 3%, directly addressing the current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable revenue. Promotional pricing is rejected despite acquisition lift because verified retention fell 12% and the cohort failed to survive first renewal. Maintain an experimental holdout because current-quarter declines may not share the same causes as the prior onboarding problem.
